# Prashanth T. (StarOne01)

> Systems Engineer based in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India. Works the gap between hardware and software: compilers, model inference, and the systems that make AI run efficiently on real silicon.

Prashanth T. — known as Ragi or StarOne01 — is a self-taught Systems Engineer and final-year Electrical & Electronics Engineering student. He started coding on a phone through Termux before owning a laptop, and now builds production clinical AI, contributes to LLVM (16 contributions and counting), and is going deep on compiler internals and MLIR. Stack: Go, Python, C++ (favorite), TypeScript/Next.js, LLVM/MLIR, QLoRA, Qdrant.

## About
- [Bio](https://starone01.me/#about): Final-year EEE student, Termux-to-production origin, now focused on MLIR and compiler internals
- [Expertise](https://starone01.me/#about): Compilers & LLVM, Production ASR & Clinical AI, ML Systems & Inference, Embeddings & Retrieval

## Work
- [Selected work](https://starone01.me/#work): Medclara, Primesoma film discovery, BrailleVision, Sherlock SFT
- [Medclara](https://starone01.me/#work): Founding engineer — IndicConformer ASR plus fine-tuned Gemma for clinical notes, ABDM/FHIR integration, built solo
- [Film discovery](https://movieslikethis.starone01.me): Custom embedding and content-fingerprinting recommender
- [PhraseNuX](https://github.com/StarOne01/PhraseNuX): Open-source C++ CLI password manager with AES encryption
- [GitHub profile](https://github.com/StarOne01): All open source code and contributions

## Research
- [Research & writing](https://starone01.me/#research): Multilingual LLM evaluation study (price/size/reputation don't predict failure; 6 models on code-switched number parsing) and StarOne Labs (Ollama deep-dives, Tamil & English)
